full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 03 June 2010 MR. LEONARDO S. PIADOZO Punong Barangay Sapang Bulak, Doha Remedios Trinidad Bulacan Dear PB Piadozo: 2010 This pertains to your letter-query seeking the legal opinion of this Department on whether or not you could still regularly receive a monthly honorarium even if presently you are detained at the Bulacan Provincial Jail in Malolos City, Bulacan, being the accused for the crime of murder in Criminal Case Nos. 1639-1642-M- 2006. Please be informed that this Department have already rendered an opinion on the same subject matter in DILG Opinion No. 55 series of 2004. In the said opinion, we opined that barangay officials are not entitled to the payment of the monthly honorarium in the absence of the required actual services rendered. Attached is a photocopy of the said opinion for your ready reference. Thank you and warm regards. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary: ATTY.JE U Director III B. DO Lega/ Semce:LD/12/e//en
